title: How to Win Back Salon Clients: Proven Strategies

facts.fact: The article 'How to Win Back Salon Clients: Proven Strategies' was published on November 29, 2024, by the Booksy Team.
The page states the article takes about 5 minutes to read.
Booksy's own Message Blasts feature can send an automatic message to customers who have not booked a visit in some time.
facts.quote: This tool allows you to send an automatic message to customers that have not booked a visit with you in some time

facts.fact: The page advises that if a client says they are not interested in welcome-back offers, the salon should stop messaging them.
facts.quote: If they tell you that they are not interested in your welcome back offers, it would be best to stop messaging them.

facts.fact: The page suggests that a salon may offer a client a lower price on a product or service only if the client brings a referral, and the referred person also receives the same discount.
facts.quote: accept their offer, but only if they bring a referral, who will also receive the same discount

facts.fact: The page suggests a discounted service package that requires clients to pay for a few sessions in advance, but it gives no specific number of sessions or discount percentage.
facts.quote: offer them a disounted service package - they will get the price they want, but only if they pay for a few sessions in advance
